director: 艾莉絲羅爾瓦雀 Alice Rohrwacher
synopsis: ★ 獲選坎城影展金棕櫚獎競賽片 每個人都有自己的「奇美拉」（Chimera，希臘神獸名，意指「夢想」），那是每個人試圖想實現、卻未能完成的渴望。對於專盜陪葬品和考古文物的盜墓小賊們來說，「奇美拉」意味著一夜致富的夢想。但對阿圖來說，「奇美拉」就像他失去的女人貝妮亞米娜。為了找到她，阿圖挑戰了無形的力量。他四處尋找，甚至深入地底，只為尋找神話裡的來世之門。在一場介乎生者與死者、城市與叢林、慶典與孤獨之間的冒險歷程中，阿圖與盜墓賊們相互交織的命運就此展開，一切都為了尋找「奇美拉」。
tmdb_overview: 來自英國的考古學家阿圖，擁有能感應地下珍貴寶物的特殊能力，他曾深愛莊園女主人的女兒貝妮亞米娜，最終卻失去了摯愛。剛從監獄放出來、狼狽落魄的他，回到貝妮亞米娜的義大利家鄉，終日魂不守舍，希望能與她再次相遇。此時一位盜墓小賊找上他尋找墓穴的寶藏，但阿圖想尋找的，卻是死亡之外的東西。
tmdb_overview_en: Everyone has their own Chimera, something they try to achieve but never manage to find. For Arthur, the Chimera looks like the woman he lost, Beniamina. In an adventurous journey between the living and the dead, between forests and cities, between celebrations and solitudes, the intertwined destinies of these characters unfold, all in search of the Chimera.

synopsis: 《終戰那一天》試圖喚回二戰時期台灣人民的生活經驗與記憶，以第一人稱視角挖掘台灣人在戰爭時期的日常，透過親身經歷台灣身份認同轉變的受訪者，帶領觀眾走進那些個人和國族在戰後轉型的曲折歷史。不僅挖掘失落的歷史篇章，更透過參戰者、反戰者、和生還者的經歷，這部紀錄片提出對戰爭的反思、對國族認同的省視，並檢視歷史如何持續形塑台灣的未來。
tmdb_overview: 《終戰那一天》挖掘了失落的歷史篇章，更透過參戰者、反戰者、和生還者的經歷，這部紀錄片提出對戰爭的反思、對國族認同的省視，並檢視歷史如何持續形塑台灣的未來。
synopsis_en:
On August 15, 1945, Japan announced its unconditional acceptance of the Potsdam Declaration via the "Jewel Voice Broadcast," officially bringing World War II to an end. For the people of Taiwan living on the island of Formosa, this day also marked the end of the world as they knew it. Japan’s colonial rule collapsed following its defeat, and the islanders—who had been "Japanese" for fifty years—became "Chinese" overnight. Caught in the rift between the warring powers of China and Japan, Taiwan was transformed from a defeated territory into a victorious nation in a single day.

*The Day the War Ended* seeks to reclaim the lived experiences and memories of the Taiwanese people during World War II. Through a first-person perspective, it unearths the daily lives of those caught in the conflict: military laborers on the front lines, "boy technicians" building aircraft, battlefield nursing assistants, normal school students aspiring to be educators, and countless ordinary citizens whose lives were upended by the war.

The film utilizes state-of-the-art colorization technology to transform black-and-white historical footage into color, recreating a vivid sense of realism. Through meticulous sound design, the soundscapes of silent archival films are fully restored. By featuring interviewees who personally lived through Taiwan’s identity shift, the documentary leads the audience into the complex personal and national histories of the post-war transition.

*The Day the War Ended* does more than just unearth lost chapters of history. Through the experiences of combatants, anti-war activists, and survivors, the documentary offers a profound reflection on war, an examination of national identity, and an investigation into how history continues to shape Taiwan’s future.

movie_title: 藍色情挑 經典數位修復
synopsis: ★ 1993 威尼斯影展金獅獎、最佳導演、最佳攝影、最佳女主角 ★ 1994 法國凱薩獎最佳女主角、最佳剪接、最佳音效 ★ 1993 洛杉磯影評人協會最佳電影音樂 ★ 1994西班牙哥雅獎最佳歐洲影片 ★ 1993 芝加哥國際影展評審團特別獎 一對音樂家夫婦皆同女兒出外，卻在旅途中發生車禍，丈夫與女兒當場死亡，只剩下音樂家妻子朱莉還活著。丈夫生前正為歐洲聯盟譜寫會歌，仍尚未完成，悲痛欲絕的她為了重拾真正的自由，決心拋開過去，甚至毀掉丈夫遺留下來未完成的手稿，以展開新生活。在音樂交織下，走出一段衝突掙扎的心路歷程。 藍、白、紅為法國國旗顏色，代表著「自由」、「平等」、「博愛」。片為波蘭電影大師奇士勞斯基「藍白紅三部曲」第一部，對應了自由，影片以藍色為主要色調在，在女主角追求新生活的過程中，反覆出現。除此之外音樂也在本片中佔有極重要的地位，襯托出人物的心理轉折，一步步走向「自由」。
tmdb_overview: 故事講述一對音樂家夫婦皆同女兒出外，旅途中發生車禍，丈夫與女兒當場死亡，只剩下音樂家妻子朱莉（茱莉葉畢諾許 飾）活著。丈夫正為歐洲共同體譜寫會歌，曲子尚未為完成，悲痛欲絕的她為了重拾真正的自由，決心拋開過去，甚至毀掉丈夫遺留下來未完成的手稿，以展開新生活。在音樂交織下，走出一段衝突掙扎的心路歷程。
tmdb_overview_en: The wife of a famous composer survives a car accident that kills her husband and daughter. Now alone, she shakes off her old identity and explores her newfound freedom but finds that she is unbreakably bound to other humans, including her husband’s mistress, whose existence she never suspected.

synopsis: 醞釀18年！《告白》《令人討厭的松子的一生》名導中島哲也睽違8年力作，交出最直擊靈魂的真摯作品 一名偵探離奇遭到殺害，負責調查案件的前同事佐竹（西島秀俊 飾）與助手聰子（滿島光 飾），循線追查竟揭開一樁塵封 9 年的新生兒綁架案。死者生前最後調查的對象，是當年失蹤、如今與父親相依為命、患有重度障礙的少年。這個被稱為「活著本身就是奇蹟」的小小生命，串起一群背負傷痛、迷失於孤獨的大人，也逐漸撼動他們冰封已久的內心，引領眾人重新思索生命、愛與救贖的真正意義。

tmdb_overview_en: When a private detective is murdered, a former colleague and a trainee detective are sent to investigate. Along the way, they uncover a tragic truth that triggers memories from their own haunted pasts.

synopsis: 一生狂畫圓點 自願住進精神病院 揭開身價最高女藝術家 不為人知的創作秘辛 「我願創作到斷氣前一刻，不斷震撼人們的心靈。」 —草間彌生 不完美的人生　畫成圓滿的愛 1977年便住進精神療養院的草間彌生，一生大展遍及全球藝術殿堂。創作數度將她從崩潰邊緣挽救回來，她的展覽吸引全球無數觀眾爭相朝聖，成為當代最具代表性與影響力的藝術家之一！ 本片走訪草間彌生的摯友、收藏家、策展人、藝術史學家，集結她橫跨半世紀的各式代表作，不但能一窺她年少時的珍貴畫稿，更能見證她勇闖紐約藝壇的大膽創舉！當年她以裸身藝術批判越戰和僵化藝術體制、在紐約主持第一場同志婚禮，更克服各種現實打擊，留下令人驚嘆的作品。 2026年8月14日，草間彌生於東京辭世，享壽97歲。直到生命最後，她依然沒有放下畫筆，將近一世紀的人生奉獻給創作。從不被理解的前衛藝術家，到享譽世界的藝術傳奇，她留下的無數圓點仍將持續蔓延，而她對藝術的愛，永遠沒有極限！ Artist Yayoi Kusama and experts discuss her life and work, from her modest beginnings in Japan to becoming an internationally renowned artist.
tmdb_overview: Now one of the world’s most celebrated artists, Yayoi Kusama broke free of the rigid society in which she was raised, and overcame sexism, racism, and mental illness to bring her artistic vision to the world stage. At 88 she lives in a mental hospital and continues to create art.

movie_title: 讓建築歌唱～徐亞英的交響人生
movie_title_en: Tuning Architecture:The Life of Albert Xu in Sound
synopsis: 華裔建築聲學大師徐亞英長年與貝聿銘、法蘭克蓋瑞等多位普立茲克獎得主的建築大師合作，以隱形的聲學設計著稱，在世界各地設計和建造了近百座文化演出和藝術展覽性建築，而他晚年的集大成之作就在台灣的衛武營國家藝術文化中心，更是他最滿意之作。建築聲學是物理、音樂、建築及科學的總合，聲學家賦予音樂穿梭於經過設計的空間，讓美好的樂音能感動人心。我們跟隨著徐老師清瘦而穩健的步伐，重回他最具代表性的作品，如羅浮宮金字塔、盧森堡愛樂音樂廳等，娓娓道來他如何為建築師解決問題，成為波宗巴克口中的「Why not」先生……。
tmdb_title: Tuning Architecture: The Life of Albert Xu in Sound
tmdb_title_en: Tuning Architecture: The Life of Albert Xu in Sound
tmdb_title_local: 讓建築歌唱～徐亞英的交響人生
tmdb_original_title: 讓建築歌唱～徐亞英的交響人生
tmdb_overview: 華裔建築聲學大師徐亞英長年與貝聿銘、法蘭克蓋瑞等多位普立茲克獎得主的建築大師合作，以隱形的聲學設計著稱，在世界各地設計和建造了近百座文化演出和藝術展覽性建築，而他晚年的集大成之作就在台灣的衛武營國家藝術文化中心，更是他最滿意之作。建築聲學是物理、音樂、建築及科學的總合，聲學家賦予音樂穿梭於經過設計的空間，讓美好的樂音能感動人心。我們跟隨著徐老師清瘦而穩健的步伐，重回他最具代表性的作品，如羅浮宮金字塔、盧森堡愛樂音樂廳等，娓娓道來他如何為建築師解決問題，成爲波宗巴克口中的『Why not』先生。他對聲學的熱情也驅使他不辭勞苦地奔波於每個設計案工地，投入一甲子的光陰追求聲音美學與空間和諧。
tmdb_overview_en: Renowned Chinese-born master of architectural acoustics, Albert Yaying Xu, spent decades collaborating with Pritzker Prize–winning architects such as I. M. Pei and Frank Gehry. Known for his “invisible” acoustic design, he has contributed to the design and construction of nearly a hundred cultural performance venues and exhibition spaces around the world. The film revisits his most iconic works—including the Louvre Pyramid and the Luxembourg Philharmonie—tracing how he resolved complex challenges for architects.

synopsis: 相米慎二青春風暴狂想曲 酷暑鬱燠難耐，一群中學少男少女們翻越圍牆，夜闖學校泳池，褪去輕薄的衣物，鬧起百無禁忌的清涼派對。在老師有意無意的放任下，同學們的遊戲尺度逐漸過激，燒灼的賀爾蒙模糊了歡愉與痛苦的界線，即便有人差點溺斃，都澆不熄眾人炙熱的玩興。數日後，強颱挾狂風暴雨過境東京，不到最後一刻不願返家的少男少女們，被迫在校園內滯留一夜⋯⋯。這場以青春為名的夏日盛宴，終將迎來刻骨銘心的高潮。
synopsis_en: Shinji Somai’s rhapsody of youthful turbulence. Amidst the stifling, unbearable heat of summer, a group of junior high students scale the school walls to break into the pool at night. Shedding their clothes, they throw a wild, taboo-free party. Under the passive, perhaps intentional, neglect of their teacher, their antics grow increasingly extreme. Searing hormones blur the line between pleasure and pain; even a near-fatal drowning cannot dampen their feverish excitement. Days later, a powerful typhoon lashes Tokyo. Reluctant to return home until the last possible second, the teenagers are forced to spend the night stranded on campus. This summer feast in the name of youth is destined for a haunting, unforgettable climax.

synopsis: 日本名導黑澤清首部時代劇作品 荒木村重（本木雅弘 飾）為了反抗暴虐無道的織田信長，決意展開籠城戰。眼看城堡隨即遭到織田軍重重包圍，整座城陷入孤立無援的境地。在戰國亂世之中，村重是一位堅守「不濫殺無辜信念」的武將。他的妻子千代保（吉高由里子 飾）是他最重要的心靈支柱，此刻也為了守護城堡與百姓而苦心竭慮。然而就在此時，城內卻發生了一起少年慘遭殺害的事件，緊接著，離奇詭異的案件接二連三地發生。嫌疑犯無疑是藏在這座宛如「密室」的城堡中，某個家臣或身邊的親信。城外是敵軍、城內是叛徒，在眾人皆陷入疑神疑鬼、草木皆兵之際，村重決定與被囚禁於地牢之中、危險卻聰穎過人的「天才軍師」黑田官兵衛（菅田將暉 飾）聯手，共同挑戰並解開這一連串的謎團。令人震驚的事件真相，以及村重最終做出的決斷究竟是⋯⋯。
tmdb_overview: When Lord Murashige rises up against the tyrannical Oda, he finds himself besieged within the walls of his own castle. Isolated, he is confronted with a series of mysterious crimes that shatter the fragile order of his court, plunging the fortress into fear and suspicion. With Oda's army closing in and a traitor hiding among his ranks, Murashige is forced into an uneasy alliance with Kanbei, a brilliant and dangerous strategist held prisoner in the dungeon, as he must outwit his enemies and uncover the truth before time runs out.

Isolated, he is confronted with a series of mysterious crimes that shatter the fragile order of his court, plunging the fortress into fear and suspicion. With Oda's army closing in and a traitor hiding among his ranks, Murashige is forced into an uneasy alliance with Kanbei, a brilliant and dangerous strategist held prisoner in the dungeon, as he must outwit his enemies and uncover the truth before time runs out.

synopsis: 坎城影展坎城首映單元正式入選 荒木村重（本木雅弘 飾）為了反抗暴虐無道的織田信長，決意展開籠城戰。眼看城堡隨即遭到織田軍重重包圍，整座城陷入孤立無援的境地。在戰國亂世之中，村重是一位堅守「不濫殺無辜信念」的武將。他的妻子千代保（吉高由里子 飾）是他最重要的心靈支柱，此刻也為了守護城堡與百姓而苦心竭慮。然而就在此時，城內卻發生了一起少年慘遭殺害的事件，緊接著，離奇詭異的案件接二連三地發生。嫌疑犯無疑是藏在這座宛如「密室」的城堡中，某個家臣或身邊的親信。城外是敵軍、城內是叛徒，在眾人皆陷入疑神疑鬼、草木皆兵之際，村重決定與被囚禁於地牢之中、危險卻聰穎過人的「天才軍師」黑田官兵衛（菅田將暉 飾）聯手，共同挑戰並解開這一連串的謎團。令人震驚的事件真相，以及村重最終做出的決斷究竟是……。 Provincial lord of the Arioka Castle, Murashige Araki, rebels against tyrannical despot Oda Nobunaga, and makes a stand at his stronghold castle. He decides to take siege but is subsequently surrounded by Oda's forces, leaving its denizens isolated and in need of allies. With the sensitive support of his wife Chiyoho, Murashige struggles to keep his hot-blooded retainers in check, while also protecting the castle and its people. One day, a young samurai is murdered within the fortress with the mysterious killer unknown. A succession of bizarre incidents follows. The suspects are Murashige's close retainers and the people inside the Arioka Castle's land. Outside, enemy troops lie in wait. Inside, traitors lie to conceal themselves. As suspicion runs rampant, Murashige seeks the help of a prisoner in his dungeon—dangerous master tactician Kanbei Kuroda—to solve the mysteries.

synopsis: 《情書》、《燕尾蝶》、《花與愛麗絲》導演岩井俊二跨時代不朽神作。 影史經典殘酷詩篇，二十週年全新數位修復衝擊大銀幕。 蓮見雄一是一名普通的高中生，他和母親、繼父和繼父帶來的弟弟一同生活。班上的風雲人物星野修介和他一同進入田徑社，兩人成了好朋友。暑假時，兩人隨同社團一起去沖繩旅遊，友情在旅途後產生變化，星野的脾氣日漸粗暴，開始欺負蓮見。蓮見默默忍受星野的霸凌，性格變得自閉孤僻。在他的心靈裡，盡是閉塞孤獨的影像。唯有當紅偶像歌手莉莉周周的歌聲才能給他慰藉……。
synopsis_en:
A timeless masterpiece from Shunji Iwai, the acclaimed director of *Love Letter*, *Swallowtail Butterfly*, and *Hana and Alice*. A cruel poem of cinematic history, this classic returns to the big screen in a stunning new 20th-anniversary digital restoration.

Yuichi Hasumi is an ordinary high school student living with his mother, stepfather, and stepbrother. He becomes close friends with the popular Shusuke Hoshino after they both join the school’s track club. However, during a summer trip to Okinawa with their club, their friendship takes a dark turn. Upon their return, Hoshino’s temperament grows increasingly violent, and he begins to ruthlessly bully Yuichi.

Enduring the abuse in silence, Yuichi withdraws into a shell of isolation. His inner world is filled with images of suffocating loneliness, where his only solace is the ethereal voice of the cult pop idol, Lily Chou-Chou...

synopsis: 20世紀文學巨擘法蘭茲卡夫卡  他的神話、厭世與夢。 年輕的卡夫卡，以律師與保險公司職員的身份生活，同時在風氣保守且經濟動盪、戰爭陰影逼近的社會中，努力平衡對文學書寫的熱情及家庭的責任。電影從19世紀在布拉格的誕生，追索卡夫卡留給世界的印記，提供觀眾一個嶄新的視角，重新認識這位文學巨人的真實人生。
tmdb_overview: 年輕的卡夫卡，白天是保險公司職員，在保守的社會、動盪的經濟與戰爭陰影步步逼近的時代，他一邊應付工作與家庭，一邊努力替自己的文字留下一席之地。從19世紀末的布拉格出發，沿著卡夫卡短暫的人生，追尋他如何一步步成為現代文學巨人，重新認識這位早在一百年前就把「厭世」書寫成藝術的大文豪。
tmdb_overview_en: Conceived as a kaleidoscopic mosaic, the film follows the imprint Franz Kafka left on the world from his birth in 19th-century Prague to his death in post-WW1 Vienna.

tmdb_overview: 深山中驚見一具神祕白骨，唯一的破案線索竟是隨屍體出土、世上僅存七副的稀世將棋。警方循線追查，所有矛頭都指向在將棋界橫空出世的天才棋士上條桂介。隨著搜查深入，知曉上條過去的關鍵人物浮出水面，那是混跡黑市賭棋界的真劍師東明重慶。當上條的身世被逐一揭開，一段超乎想像且殘酷的過往也將公諸於世。
tmdb_overview_en: Keisuke, a 10-year-old boy, living hard despite being abused by his father, finds a ray of light in the midst of his suffering and conflict ---- a shogi world where he fights quietly and passionately in his sharpened senses. Even though he gives up and tries to escape from the light, his passion for shogi continues to guide him thereafter. Eventually, he would learn the true meaning of life.

synopsis: 天下藥廠推出「健美素」，經理袁德安招考「廣告美人」造勢。祕書楊耀天之女藍絲瞞著父親參加甄選，請男友王文輝協助。兩人察覺袁德安別有企圖，暗中阻撓，藍絲仍晉級；熱鬧選美背後，危險正逐步逼近。 台語片與廈語片因語言相近，自五〇年代初便共享東南亞市場。本片承接李臨秋投資《桃花鄉》後的新興廈語片風潮，在香港製作，先於新加坡首映，隔年進入台灣時改名《餓狗想食豬肝骨》，以更貼近當地觀眾的片名與宣傳重新定位。莊雪芳此前已憑《歌女白蘭花》及插曲〈給我親一個〉紅遍星馬與台灣；她在片中的歌唱、時裝與明快肢體，將選美、廣告與都市消費化為鮮明的節奏，也賦予影片摩登、大膽而耳目一新的氣息。 To promote its new health tonic, a pharmaceutical company launches a search for an "advertising beauty." Lan-si enters in secret with the help of her boyfriend, but they soon discover that the company president has ulterior motives. Produced in Hong Kong and first released in Singapore, the film reflects an Amoy-dialect cinema shaped by stars, songs, advertising, and urban consumption. Zhuang Xuefang's singing, fashionable costumes, and lively performance turn the beauty contest into a display of modernity, commerce, and danger. * 本珍貴拷貝因聲軌缺損有段落無聲，請斟酌觀賞。 * Please be advised that due to damage to the audio track, this rare print contains silent segments.

tmdb_overview: 天下药厂推出新产品《健美素》，总经理袁德安（王清河）吩咐秘书杨耀天（胡同）以招考广告美人做宣传。杨耀天女儿蓝丝（庄雪芳）在报上看到广告希望参选，遂要求男友王文辉（黄英）帮忙。。杨耀天及王文辉发觉袁德安对蓝丝有歹意，分别暗中阻扰蓝丝，但最终蓝丝还是当选。在招待酒会后袁德安借故把蓝丝带往郊外，图谋不轨。袁德安的妻子赶来，及时阻止。最后蓝丝和王文辉结尾夫妻。（故事源自左几1958年导演粤语片广告女郎)
synopsis_en:
Tianxia Pharmaceutical has launched its new "Jianmeisu" health tonic, and manager Yuan De’an is holding an "Advertising Beauty" contest to drum up publicity. Lan-si, the daughter of secretary Yang Yaotian, enters the competition in secret with the help of her boyfriend, Wang Wenhui. Although the pair senses that Yuan De’an has ulterior motives and attempts to thwart him, Lan-si still advances in the pageant. Behind the lively festivities, danger is gradually closing in.

Due to their linguistic similarities, Hokkien and Amoy-dialect films shared the Southeast Asian market starting in the early 1950s. Following the wave of Amoy-dialect cinema sparked by Li Lin-chiu’s investment in *The Village of Peach Blossoms*, this film was produced in Hong Kong and premiered in Singapore. When it arrived in Taiwan the following year, it was retitled *Hungry Dog Wants to Eat Pig Liver Bone* to better appeal to local audiences through its title and promotion. Lead actress Zhuang Xuefang had already become a sensation across Singapore, Malaysia, and Taiwan with *The Singing Girl, White Orchid* and its hit song "Give Me a Kiss." Her singing, fashionable costumes, and spirited performance turn the themes of beauty pageants, advertising, and urban consumption into a vivid rhythm, imbuing the film with a modern, bold, and refreshing atmosphere.

* Please be advised that due to damage to the audio track, this rare print contains silent segments.

tmdb_overview: 雙胞胎兄弟科拉與瓦沙從小就被父親拋棄，二十年後，放浪不羈的科拉成了一名公車司機，卻暗中販毒當藥頭；保守木訥的瓦沙則當上一名警察，過著平凡的家庭生活。缺席的父親在科拉心中仍是個大英雄，對瓦沙而言卻是個大混蛋。一天他們意外接到父親在盧森堡即將病逝的消息，疏離的兄弟倆雖抱持著不同的念頭，卻決定一起上路出發，從烏克蘭開車前往盧森堡，踏上去見爸爸最後一面的冒險旅程。
tmdb_overview_en: Kolya and Vasylii learn that their father, who left them when they were children, is dying in Luxembourg, far away from them. One of them wants to go and find his father, while the other one does everything he can to prevent the first from leaving the country. As a result, they both go to Luxembourg in search of their dad: Kolya considers him a hero, while Vasylii thinks he is a scoundrel.

synopsis: 《欣德之聲》改編自加薩戰爭的真實事件，2024年1月29日，紅新月會接獲一通緊急求救電話。戰火爆發之際，一名年僅六歲的女孩獨自受困車內，她在通話中哭喊「我好害怕...坦克車就在我身旁。」眼看救援時間不斷流逝，砲火轟鳴與尖叫聲也從未間斷，志工們只能在未知中盼望奇蹟，危機卻步步逼近。

synopsis: 阿雪與康丁靠擦鞋維生，晴美、美娥則在酒家工作，眾人在台北相依度日。吝嗇又好色的胡老爺為敷衍美娥，買下一枚假鑽戒，不料銀樓誤把贗品給成真貨，而假戒指又錯給了他人，引發一連串誤會。此時，晴美的母親突然進城探望，曾謊稱自己嫁給經理的晴美，如今只得設法圓謊，一場真假難辨的鬧劇就此展開。 以貧窮、酒家勞動與都市謀生為背景，透過誤認、假扮與插科打諢，將生活壓力轉成喜劇。矮仔財的八字鬍、瘦小身形與誇張動作，與卓別林形成視覺對照，也顯示好萊塢的喜劇形式，如何被台語片演員的身體挪用，進入台語對白與城市生活。豪宅裡，擦鞋工與酒家女扮成體面家庭，胡氏夫婦反成傭人。主人與僕役、富人與窮人的身分交換，未必消除貧富差距，卻讓都市階級秩序在笑聲中短暫倒置。

synopsis_en:
Ah Xue and Kang Ding scrape by as shoeshiners, while Qingmei and Mei’e work in a hostess house; together, they navigate the struggles of life in Taipei. The stingy and lecherous Master Hu buys a fake diamond ring to appease Mei’e, but the jewelry store accidentally hands him a real one instead. Meanwhile, the fake ring ends up in the wrong hands, triggering a chaotic chain of misunderstandings. Just then, Qingmei’s mother arrives in the city for a surprise visit. Having previously lied about being married to a manager, Qingmei is forced to scramble to maintain the charade, setting the stage for a dizzying farce where truth and deception are indistinguishable.

Set against a backdrop of poverty, nightlife labor, and the struggle for urban survival, the film transforms the pressures of daily life into comedy through mistaken identities, impersonations, and slapstick humor. Shorty Choi’s handlebar mustache, diminutive stature, and exaggerated movements draw a visual parallel to Charlie Chaplin, illustrating how Hollywood comedic tropes were appropriated by Taiwanese-language cinema actors and integrated into local dialogue and urban life. Inside a grand mansion, the shoeshiners and hostess girls pose as a high-society family, while Master Hu and his wife are relegated to the roles of servants. This role reversal between master and servant, rich and poor, may not erase the wealth gap, but it allows the urban class hierarchy to be briefly—and hilariously—inverted.

synopsis: 少女麗芬與秋生相戀，卻遭美珍設局陷害，意外被美珍之父源興搭救。源興因此與舊愛秀梅重逢，驚覺麗芬竟是親生女兒。兩代人的三角關係、被謊言中斷的戀情與塵封身世，遂在家庭倫理劇中交纏，也迫使少女重新理解母親、愛情與成人世界。 辛奇延續《危險的青春》對都市青年與女性處境的關注，將兩代人的三角關係疊合在家庭倫理劇中。泳池、派對、咖啡廳、舞廳與汽車，構成六〇年代的青春場景。戀愛與自由的想望，仍受家庭祕密、婚姻安排與男性暴力包圍，也使影片與同時期東亞青春電影形成可供並置的鄰近關係。台語對白間穿插國語流行歌與西洋搖滾，不同語言與曲風交錯，讓家庭通俗劇接上跨區流動的青年文化。 Li-fen falls in love with Qiu-sheng, but Mei-zhen's jealousy draws her into danger. Rescued by Mei-zhen's father, Yuan-xing, she becomes the link to his long-lost lover, Xiu-mei, and a buried family secret. Hsin Chi sets this two-generation melodrama amid pools, parties, cafés, dance halls, and cars. Taiwanese dialogue mixes with Mandarin pop and Western rock, connecting constrained youthful desire to wider currents of East Asian youth culture.

synopsis_en:
Young Li-fen and Qiu-sheng are deeply in love, but their romance is sabotaged by the jealous Mei-zhen. When Mei-zhen’s father, Yuan-xing, unexpectedly rescues Li-fen from a trap, the encounter leads to a reunion with his former lover, Xiu-mei—and the shocking revelation that Li-fen is actually his biological daughter. Love triangles spanning two generations, romances severed by lies, and long-buried secrets collide in this family melodrama, forcing Li-fen to confront the complexities of her mother’s past, the nature of love, and the harsh realities of the adult world.

Building on the themes of urban youth and the female experience explored in *Dangerous Youth*, director Hsin Chi weaves a multi-generational web of relationships into a classic family drama. Set against a vibrant 1960s backdrop of swimming pools, parties, cafes, dance halls, and cars, the film depicts a yearning for love and freedom that remains stifled by family secrets, arranged marriages, and male violence. By blending Taiwanese Hokkien dialogue with Mandarin pop and Western rock, Hsin Chi bridges the gap between traditional melodrama and the transnational currents of contemporary East Asian youth culture.

synopsis_en:
In the late Qing Dynasty, as opium addiction ravages the land, Lin Guoliang, the son of a wealthy family, squanders his entire fortune on his habit and even sells his own son to buy more drugs. Meanwhile, a young woman named Ai-lan and her blind sister, Li-lan, are forced to sing in opium dens for a living, eventually being unwittingly manipulated into smuggling drugs. After the sisters are accidentally separated, Ai-lan is rescued by Mu Ziying, a subordinate of Commissioner Lin Zexu, and begins assisting him in tracking down smuggling leads. As Lin Zexu launches his anti-opium campaign, the tragedies of the addicts, the collusion between corrupt officials and merchants, and the sisters' search for one another become inextricably linked.

This film can be read alongside Masahiro Makino’s 1943 Japanese national policy film, *The Opium War*, as the two share many parallels in character names, the trope of separated sisters, and scenes set in opium dens. Director Li Quanxi gradually weaves multiple character arcs together, using musical sequences to bridge personal suffering with the broader theme of opium prohibition. The playback singing by Chen Fen-lan further heightens the emotional resonance of the blind sister’s character. The film’s ending goes as far as to link the evils of opium to the "People's Communes," reframing this historical subject within the anti-communist discourse of 1960s Taiwan.

synopsis: 在零食與人類和睦共存的「甜品王國」，誕生了享譽全球的超人氣偶像團體「愉快動物餅」，他們能歌善舞，正進行世界巡演。然而，隊長大獅與新成員小天馬的關係卻略顯緊張。小天馬以其美妙歌聲與空中飛舞的 表演贏得觀眾喝彩，大獅卻因此心生嫉妒，擔心自己的明星地位被奪。此時，愉快動物餅睽違一年回到甜品王國，卻發現整座城市被棉花糖覆蓋。他們隨即遇到脾氣暴躁的棉花糖，邀請他們前往甜品王國參加派對。 原來，棉花糖國王意圖消滅所有棉花糖以外的零食，從而實現征服世界的可怕夢想！ 棉花糖國王露出真面目，帶著敵意向愉快動物餅發起攻擊。他們在城堡巧遇一名叫 「佩羅」的小女孩，在她的帶領下僥倖逃脫。然而，為保護同伴，小天馬獨自對抗棉花糖大軍，不幸被擄。愉快動物餅被馬卡龍博士收留，這位博士收養了孤兒佩羅。一團黏在大獅鬃毛上的小棉花糖「記憶棉(阿棉)」也隨之同行。為救回珍貴同伴，必須擊敗最強敵人。在阿棉的協助下，大獅帶領隊員們團結一心，奔向城堡。這些為帶來歡樂而誕生的愉快動物餅，能否戰勝棉花糖國王，救出 小天馬並守護世界？身陷絕境的他們，又將發現何種扭轉乾坤的秘策？

synopsis_en:
In the "Sweet Kingdom," where snacks and humans live in harmony, the world-renowned idol group "Tabekko Doubutsu" has taken the world by storm. Famous for their singing and dancing, the group is currently in the middle of a global tour. However, tension is brewing between the leader, Lion, and the new member, Pegasus. As Pegasus wins over audiences with his beautiful voice and soaring aerial performances, Lion becomes consumed by jealousy, fearing his status as the star is under threat.

Returning to the Sweet Kingdom after a year away, the group discovers the entire city has been buried under layers of cotton candy. They are soon met by a grumpy cotton candy messenger who invites them to a party at the castle. It is there that the Cotton Candy King reveals his true colors: he intends to eliminate all snacks other than cotton candy to fulfill his dark ambition of world conquest!

As the King launches a hostile attack, the group manages a narrow escape thanks to a young girl named Pero. However, Pegasus is captured by the cotton candy army after staying behind to protect his teammates. Seeking refuge, the group is taken in by Dr. Macaron, Pero’s adoptive father. They are joined by "Mien," a tiny piece of "Memory Cotton" that has stuck itself to Lion’s mane.

To rescue their precious companion, the team must face their most formidable foe yet. Guided by Mien and led by a now-determined Lion, the group unites to storm the castle. Can these animals, born to bring joy to the world, defeat the Cotton Candy King, rescue Pegasus, and protect the world? In their moment of greatest peril, what secret strategy will they uncover to turn the tide of battle?

movie_title: 裝配台語：從農宣片到《飛天三輪車》
movie_title_en: Assembling Taiyu: From Rural Educational Films to Flying Pedicab
synopsis: 農婦阿秀在農業指導員協助下，學習肥料配比、儲存與堆肥。影片把農業講習嵌入若有似無的情愫與歌聲，讓政策知識在家庭、田間與表演之間流動。 糊塗老二（如何使用農藥 ） 文泉 WEN Chuan｜台灣 Taiwan｜1960｜DCP｜B&W｜18min 總被笑作糊塗的阿肥，為證明自己逞強噴灑農藥，卻因未做防護引發意外。影片以喜劇節奏示範正確施藥與中毒急救，也留下農村現代化的身體代價。 畜牧生產在台灣 The Livestock Industry in Taiwan 莊國鈞 CHUANG Kuo-chun｜台灣 Taiwan｜1953｜DCP｜B&W｜19min 影片以生活化的台語旁白、國樂小調與理想化農家景象，介紹外來種豬與本地母豬的配種、飼養及防疫，將專業知識轉譯為親近農民的視聽經驗。 飛天三輪車 （殘片） Flying Pedicab (Fragment) 莊國鈞 CHUANG Kuo-chun｜台灣 Taiwan｜1967｜DCP｜B&W｜2min × 3 青年職員忠誠鑽研電磁學，成功讓三輪車飛上天空，卻也捲入淑美與廠長千金碧如之間的情感糾葛。電影由丁伯駪的亞洲影業出品，影片目前僅存兩分鐘殘片。

synopsis_en:
Ah-xiu, a farmwoman, learns about fertilizer ratios, storage, and composting with the help of an agricultural instructor. The film weaves agricultural instruction into a subtle romance and song, allowing policy knowledge to flow between the home, the fields, and performance.

**The Muddled Second Son (How to Use Pesticides)**
WEN Chuan｜Taiwan｜1960｜DCP｜B&W｜18min
Ah-fei, often ridiculed for being "muddled," tries to prove his worth by insisting on spraying pesticides himself. However, his failure to use protective gear leads to an accident. Using a comedic rhythm, the film demonstrates proper application and emergency first aid for poisoning, while also capturing the physical toll of rural modernization.

**The Livestock Industry in Taiwan**
CHUANG Kuo-chun｜Taiwan｜1953｜DCP｜B&W｜19min
Featuring colloquial Taiwanese narration, traditional Chinese melodies, and idealized farm scenes, the film introduces the breeding of foreign boars with local sows, as well as feeding and epidemic prevention. It translates technical expertise into an accessible audiovisual experience for farmers.

**Flying Pedicab (Fragment)**
CHUANG Kuo-chun｜Taiwan｜1967｜DCP｜B&W｜2min × 3
Zhong-cheng, a young clerk dedicated to the study of electromagnetics, successfully makes a pedicab fly. However, he becomes entangled in a romantic conflict between Shu-mei and Bi-ru, the daughter of the factory manager. Produced by Ting Po-shen’s Asia Film Company, only a two-minute fragment of the film survives today.

Seventeen-year-old Tang Dan-mei is a diligent student with a secret: she is deeply in love with her cousin, Feng Ze. synopsis_en:
Director Pai Ching-jui Special Retrospective ★ 1971 Golden Horse Awards Special Award for Best Technical Achievement

Kuei-chih is the conductor of a women’s Western-style marching band in Tainan who has always maintained a cautious guard against men. However, she eventually succumbs to the persistent advances of the rogue Ah-lang. For the sake of love, she risks everything—becoming pregnant out of wedlock, breaking off an engagement, and absconding with money to elope with him to Kaohsiung. Unfortunately, Ah-lang remains a shiftless failure. While Kuei-chih tries to persuade him to move to Taipei for a fresh start, Ah-lang becomes addicted to the thrill of his vices; the more she pleads, the more reckless and unhinged he becomes. Adapted from Taiwanese author Chen Ying-zhen’s story "A Race of Generals," director Pai Ching-jui and cinematographer Lin Tsan-ting forge a path for avant-garde realist cinema. 

Special thanks to the co-organizers of this retrospective.

synopsis_en: An Kazutaka is a young psychiatrist and professional jazz pianist. A shy man who enjoys mahjong and reading, he is a second-generation Korean living in Japan who spent much of his youth searching for his own identity. Shortly after the birth of his first son, the Great Hanshin Earthquake strikes, turning his workplace, Kobe University Hospital, into a makeshift field hospital. In the aftermath, he begins to question what he can truly contribute as a psychiatrist. By staying by the side of the survivors and listening to their stories, Kazutaka comes to realize that the role of a psychiatrist is not merely to "cure" patients, but to help them rediscover their own innate power of resilience.

tmdb_overview: 在二戰期間，「布達佩斯大飯店」可是聲名最顯赫的大飯店，冠蓋雲集、政商名流都要爭相入住，常常一房難求。善舞又會察言觀色的門房總管葛斯塔夫（雷夫費恩斯　飾演）負責打點一切，某天他卻遇上了一樁麻煩事，紅顏知己、高齡80多歲的D夫人（蒂達史雲頓　飾演）突然暴斃，並留下大筆遺產給他。  這下可引起D夫人的家族不滿，不僅黑道來追殺他，連警察也要逮捕他。還好葛斯塔夫也不是省油的燈，他把年輕新進門房季諾教導得服服貼貼，幫他裡應外合，但是在資訊不發達的時代，他要怎麼串聯各大飯店幫他度過難關？
tmdb_overview_en: The Grand Budapest Hotel tells of a legendary concierge at a famous European hotel between the wars and his friendship with a young employee who becomes his trusted protégé. The story involves the theft and recovery of a priceless Renaissance painting, the battle for an enormous family fortune and the slow and then sudden upheavals that transformed Europe during the first half of the 20th century.

synopsis: 原文發音、中文字幕 — 熱愛音樂的兩位陌生男女，相遇浪漫的都柏林街頭，在生活大不易的環境下，勉強的做著一份得以糊口的工作，盼望著看似遙遠但可能的幸福未來。 音樂成為了他們抒發與彼此傾訴的管道，愛爾蘭男孩懊悔著劈腿且在倫敦工作的前女友，而捷克女孩則一人帶著母親與女兒，期待與遠在家鄉的丈夫重新相聚的一天。 於是，他們說好一起製作一張專輯，夾雜了回憶及動人的情感，還有那些說不出口的話。 — Doors open 21:15｜Screening 21:45｜Runtime 1h 26m｜Protected (6+) Original audio, Mandarin subtitles — Two strangers who love music meet on the romantic streets of Dublin, scraping by on jobs that barely cover the rent, hoping for a happiness that feels far off but not impossible. Music becomes the way they open up to each other — the Irish busker still aching over an ex who cheated and moved to London, the Czech girl raising a daughter alongside her mother, waiting for the day she and her husband back home are together again. And so they agree to make a record together, full of memories, of feeling, and of everything neither of them ever managed to say out loud. —

synopsis: 2025 坎城影展 Cannes FF 2025 安錫國際動畫影展 Annecy International Animation FF 2026 奧斯卡最佳動畫長片提名 Nominated for Best Animated Feature, Academy Awards 三歲那年，愛蜜莉的世界悄然展開。一次與巧克力的奇妙邂逅，點燃了她對萬物的好奇，也讓她從自以為是的神明，化身為感知世界的幼童。在四季流轉間，她與溫柔的日本保母西尾小姐結下深厚情誼，從漢字、鯉魚與微風中，初次體會愛、失落與生命的靜謐波動。這段身處日本異鄉的童年歲月，如夢似幻、如雨般輕柔，一點一滴浸潤著她的心靈，帶領她踏上一場溫柔而深刻的成長旅程。 At three years old, little Amélie's universe quietly begins to unfold. A magical encounter with white chocolate awakens her curiosity, transforming her from a self-proclaimed god into a child observing the world anew. As the seasons change in post-war Japan, she forms a deep, affectionate bond with her gentle nanny, Nishio-san, discovering love, loss, and the subtle rhythms of life through rain, koi fish, and quiet moments. Soft as rain and vivid as a dream, this enchanting story captures a sensitive child's journey of learning what it truly means to be human. ◤童心電影院：借一雙電影眼 Theater of Wonders: Through Magic Movie Eyes!◢ 本季邀請大小朋友戴上魔法眼鏡，從藝術家的想像、戰火角落的勇氣、異鄉童年的驚奇，到微觀世界的冒險，讓我們借用他人眼睛，學習同理心、擁抱世界多樣性，開展自由飛翔的魔法之旅吧！ 小小畫家芙烈達 小雨愛蜜莉 Little Amélie or the Character of Rain 戰火下的小花 魔籽公主

Then he meets Patrick and Sam, who take his strangeness in stride and pull him into a world of parties, music and freedom. In the ache of adolescence, this group of misfits learns how to hold on to each other at the edge of falling apart. —

tmdb_overview: 查理（羅根勒曼飾）是個害羞內向的高一學生，早熟的他總是默默觀察身邊的親友，是個不折不扣的「壁花男孩」。從一封封查理寫給不知名的「親愛的朋友」的信中，我們越來越認識查理。查理遇到了許多青少年在這個年紀會遇到的挫折如：交友、感情、性探索、毒品，同時他還必須從兒時姑姑的意外死亡陰影中走出來。還好他在學校遇到了好友珊（艾瑪華特森飾演），給他許多幫助和友情，共享他最真實、最坦承、如日記般親切動人的生命．．．  艾瑪在閱讀本片劇本時，即落下感動不已的淚水，片中她飾演活潑外向、勇於探索的高中女生「珊」，幫助害羞、沒有朋友的「查理」（羅根勒曼飾）融入校園生活，找到自我。

But Andy does the guards’ taxes, cooks the warden’s books, writes letters for six years until he gets a library — and one afternoon, puts opera out over the prison loudspeakers. Red, who has spent most of his life behind those walls, watches all of it and says there is something in this man the walls cannot hold...... —

synopsis_en:
Director Pai Ching-jui Special Retrospective ★ 1971 Golden Horse Awards Special Award for Best Technical Achievement

Kuei-chih is the conductor of a women’s Western-style marching band in Tainan who has always maintained a cautious guard against men. However, she eventually succumbs to the persistent advances of the rogue Ah-lang. For the sake of love, she risks everything—becoming pregnant out of wedlock, breaking off an engagement, and absconding with money to elope with him to Kaohsiung. Unfortunately, Ah-lang remains a shiftless failure. While Kuei-chih tries to persuade him to move to Taipei for a fresh start, Ah-lang becomes addicted to the thrill of his vices; the more she pleads, the more reckless and unhinged he becomes. Adapted from Taiwanese author Chen Ying-zhen’s story "A Race of Generals," director Pai Ching-jui and cinematographer Lin Tsan-ting forge a path for avant-garde realist cinema. 

Special thanks to the co-organizers of this retrospective.

synopsis_en:
Director Pai Ching-jui Special Retrospective ★ 1968 Golden Horse Awards: Best Director, Best Color Cinematography, Special Award for Technical Achievement, Best Editing, Best Color Art Direction, and Best Sound Recording.

Seventeen-year-old Tang Dan-mei is a diligent student with a secret: she is deeply in love with her cousin, Feng Ze. A dashing and charismatic man, Feng Ze spends his time playing the field between the Tang sisters and his former girlfriend. When a tragic car accident claims Feng Ze’s life, it also shatters Dan-mei’s romantic dreams. Traumatized, she is hospitalized for electroconvulsive therapy, yet nothing can erase the crushing guilt of believing she was responsible for his death. This film explores the loneliness and uncertainty of youth under the weight of academic pressure and parental alienation. Featuring superstars Tang Pao-yun and Ko Chun-hsiung, director Pai Ching-jui delivered a major box office hit. 

Special thanks to the co-organizers of this retrospective.

synopsis_en:
Director Pai Ching-jui Special Feature: In a Taipei apartment building, Zhang Zhenzhen, the only daughter of an upper-middle-class family, runs away from home in a fit of pique after being grounded by her father for several days. Wang Huacheng, a middle-class professional, bids his wife farewell for an overnight business trip, only to rush into the arms of an ex-girlfriend visiting from America. Meanwhile, Hong Jingde, the head of a lower-class household, reaches his breaking point with his noisy children and announces early in the morning that he will be working late. As the three venture out, their paths cross during the long night, and each must decide before dawn whether or not to return home. Director Pai Ching-jui employs a multi-linear narrative to craft a groundbreaking new urban comedy. 

Special thanks to the co-organizers of this feature.

synopsis: 2024 安錫國際動畫影展 Annecy International Animation FF 在色彩繽紛、熱情奔放的墨西哥科約阿坎小鎮，住著一個與眾不同的小女孩。對這個世界充滿無窮好奇心的她，即使面對生命突如其來的考驗與折磨，也總能用天馬行空的想像力迎頭擊破。這個勇敢、燦爛又獨一無二的小女孩，名字就叫——芙烈達卡蘿！本片以充滿童趣與藝術感的視覺風格，帶領我們借用小芙烈達的眼睛，看見想像力如何化為力量，將生活的痛楚綻放出最耀眼的色彩。 Welcome to the vibrant world of Coyoacán, Mexico, home to an extraordinary little girl with endless curiosity. tmdb_overview: 這是一個關於一位與眾不同的小女孩的故事。她的名字叫做芙烈達·卡蘿！故事從她的童年與青年時期出發，在墨西哥的科約阿坎，一個閃耀而充滿生命力的地方展開。這裡的一切都今她充滿好奇，也讓她在成長的每一刻，都以敏銳而炙熱的感知擁抱世界。當困難與病痛來臨時，她從不退縮，而是以豐富而奔放的想像力去面對。那些痛苦、孤獨與愛，在她的眼中逐漸轉化為色彩與形狀，滲入畫布之中，成為無法被抹去的生命印記。正如芙烈達所說：「我從不畫夢境，我畫的是我的現實。」她的創作不逃避現實，反而直視生命最真實的傷口與光芒。

synopsis: 1999 奧斯卡金像獎最佳影片、女主角、女配角、原創劇本、服裝設計、美術指導、配樂（原創音樂劇或喜劇類）Best Picture, Best Leading Actress, Best Supporting Actress, Best 1999 柏林影展傑出成就銀熊獎（編劇）Outstanding Single Achievement (Screenwriting), Berlinale 1593年，倫敦劇場界正值繁華盛世，年輕劇作家威廉卻苦陷創作瓶頸。直到他遇見熱愛劇場的富商千金薇拉，一場不容於世俗規範的戀情悄然展開。當薇拉巧扮男裝登上舞台，威廉開始重拾靈感泉源，並隨後發現她的真實身份。現實中與愛情繆斯的邂逅與離別，最終催生他筆下經典的世仇悲戀：《羅密歐與茱麗葉》。 好萊塢編劇馬克諾曼耗費多年構思，最終由英國劇作家湯姆史塔帕執筆完成劇本。史塔帕曾以取材《哈姆雷特》的荒謬主義劇作《君臣人子小命嗚呼》榮獲東尼獎，憑藉其深厚的莎劇底蘊、幽默筆法，靈巧重塑本片對白及情節，將莎翁生平交織浪漫悲喜劇，融冶成一齣絕妙戲中戲。 ◤關於電影的電影：幕間人生 All About Cinema: Between the Acts◢ 本季 節目透過電影鏡頭，凝視劇場及現實生活的交會。幕間舞台下的悲歡流轉，是戲劇的停頓，亦是人生的轉場。且看創作者卸下面具、回望自身，在虛實交錯間，直抵幽微的生命真相。 哈姆奈特 莎翁情史 在車上 42街的凡尼亞

synopsis: 1988 金馬獎最佳電影插歌曲 Best Original Film Song, Golden Horse Awards 南特影展 Festival des 3 Continents 小敏高中未畢業便被父母安排訂婚，但她對外面的世界充滿好奇，與少年約會玩樂。成年後她走入無愛無性的婚姻，苦悶的主婦日常卻因一名闖入家中的青年而改變。離婚後，雖偶感寂寞，小敏仍對親密關係感到迷惘。 1980年代中後期，台灣經濟泡沫化，台灣電影遭遇嚴峻資金困境。湯臣電影公司有別於同業搶拍社會事件或引進港片，致力關注於1980年代中葉到解嚴後國內新興的婦女議題，從《殺夫》、《心鎖》到《黃色故事》，將1980年代間女性面對的困境，如性騷擾、性權利、性教育、感情自主等議題搬上大銀幕。本片起用甫出道的港星張曼玉，新生代編劇人才王小棣、蔡明亮和蘇偉貞，以明星結合新一代編導的方式，獲得商業與藝術兼具的成績。

Before even graduating from high school, Xiao-min is forced into an arranged engagement by her parents. Driven by curiosity about the world, she spends her youth dating and seeking excitement. As an adult, she enters a loveless and sexless marriage, but her monotonous life as a housewife is suddenly disrupted when a young man breaks into her home. Following her divorce, though she occasionally feels the sting of loneliness, Xiao-min remains bewildered by the complexities of intimacy.

In the mid-to-late 1980s, as Taiwan’s economic bubble grew, the domestic film industry faced a severe funding crisis. Unlike its competitors, who rushed to dramatize sensational social scandals or import Hong Kong action films, Tomson Films dedicated itself to the emerging women's issues of the post-martial law era. From *The Woman of Wrath* and *The Lock of Love* to *Game They Call Sex*, the studio brought the struggles of 1980s women—including sexual harassment, sexual rights, sex education, and emotional autonomy—to the big screen. Featuring a then-newcomer Maggie Cheung alongside a talented new generation of writers including Wang Hsiao-di, Tsai Ming-liang, and Su Wei-chen, the film successfully blended star power with a fresh creative vision to achieve both commercial and artistic success.

synopsis: 2025 坎城影展 Cannes FF 2025 安錫國際動畫影展 Annecy International Animation FF 2026 奧斯卡最佳動畫長片提名 Nominated for Best Animated Feature, Academy Awards 三歲那年，愛蜜莉的世界悄然展開。一次與巧克力的奇妙邂逅，點燃了她對萬物的好奇，也讓她從自以為是的神明，化身為感知世界的幼童。在四季流轉間，她與溫柔的日本保母西尾小姐結下深厚情誼，從漢字、鯉魚與微風中，初次體會愛、失落與生命的靜謐波動。這段身處日本異鄉的童年歲月，如夢似幻、如雨般輕柔，一點一滴浸潤著她的心靈，帶領她踏上一場溫柔而深刻的成長旅程。 At three years old, little Amélie's universe quietly begins to unfold. synopsis: 日文發音、中英字幕 — 天才科學家開發出能進入他人夢境的儀器「DC Mini」，卻不幸遭到偷竊。盜賊利用它入侵研究員的精神，引發一連串荒誕的集體瘋狂。精神治療師千葉敦子化身為夢境偵探 Paprika，穿梭在斑斕、扭曲且失控的夢境世界中，試圖在現實全面崩塌前，揪出幕後的黑手。 — Doors open 18:30｜Screening 19:15｜Runtime 1h 30m｜PG-12 Japanese audio, Mandarin & English subtitles — A brilliant scientist develops the DC Mini, a device that lets you enter other people’s dreams — and then it is stolen. The thief uses it to break into researchers’ minds, setting off a wave of absurd collective madness. Therapist Atsuko Chiba becomes Paprika, a detective inside the dream world, moving through its bright, warping, runaway landscapes to find whoever is behind it before reality collapses for good. —

synopsis: 原文發音、中文字幕 — 哈利與莎莉，在感情觀念與個性上截然不同的兩人，卻總是陰錯陽差的湊在一起。 但幾次的相遇，他們臉紅脖子粗地爭論著彼此認為的男女關係，看似各有立場，卻誰也無法說服對方，不歡而散。 幾年後，他們分別歷經了離婚與感情挫折，哈利與莎莉又再次相遇。 但誰也說不準，這會是意想不到的友情，或是苦盡甘來的愛情呢? — Doors open 18:30｜Screening 19:15｜Runtime 1h 36m｜Parental Guidance Original audio, Mandarin subtitles — Harry and Sally could not be less alike, in temperament or in how they see relationships — and yet they keep being thrown together. Years later, after a divorce and a heartbreak between them, Harry and Sally meet again. And nobody can say whether this becomes an unlikely friendship, or a love that took the long way round. —

tmdb_overview: 大學畢業時，哈利在旅途中偶遇了莎莉，倆人聊得並不愉快。哈利認為男女之間不可能有真正的友誼，莎莉卻不以為然，於是不歡而散。5年後，倆人又在飛機上巧遇，這時他們都有了意中人，但觀點卻沒有改變，再次不歡而散。  當倆人再相逢時，都因感情出現了危機而有了共同語言。哈利此時也有些相信男女之間可以有純潔友誼了。他們相互為對方介紹對象，沒想到找來的一男一女卻陷入了熱戀之中，令人哭笑不得。隨著對彼此理解的加深，倆人超出了友誼的界限，事後卻又有些不安和後悔。  新年之夜，哈利忽然領悟到友誼和愛情可以同時存在，於是他瘋狂地找尋莎莉....
tmdb_overview_en: Sex always gets in the way of friendships between men and women. At least, that's what Harry Burns believes. synopsis: 1988 金馬獎最佳電影插歌曲 Best Original Film Song, Golden Horse Awards 南特影展 Festival des 3 Continents 小敏高中未畢業便被父母安排訂婚，但她對外面的世界充滿好奇，與少年約會玩樂。成年後她走入無愛無性的婚姻，苦悶的主婦日常卻因一名闖入家中的青年而改變。離婚後，雖偶感寂寞，小敏仍對親密關係感到迷惘。 1980年代中後期，台灣經濟泡沫化，台灣電影遭遇嚴峻資金困境。湯臣電影公司有別於同業搶拍社會事件或引進港片，致力關注於1980年代中葉到解嚴後國內新興的婦女議題，從《殺夫》、《心鎖》到《黃色故事》，將1980年代間女性面對的困境，如性騷擾、性權利、性教育、感情自主等議題搬上大銀幕。本片起用甫出道的港星張曼玉，新生代編劇人才王小棣、蔡明亮和蘇偉貞，以明星結合新一代編導的方式，獲得商業與藝術兼具的成績。

Before even graduating from high school, Xiao-min is forced into an arranged engagement by her parents. Driven by curiosity about the world, she spends her youth dating and seeking excitement. As an adult, she enters a loveless and sexless marriage, but her monotonous life as a housewife is suddenly disrupted when a young man breaks into her home. Following her divorce, though she occasionally feels the sting of loneliness, Xiao-min remains bewildered by the complexities of intimacy.

In the mid-to-late 1980s, as Taiwan’s economic bubble grew, the domestic film industry faced a severe funding crisis. Unlike its competitors, who rushed to dramatize sensational social scandals or import Hong Kong action films, Tomson Films dedicated itself to the emerging women's issues of the post-martial law era. From *The Woman of Wrath* and *The Lock of Love* to *Game They Call Sex*, the studio brought the struggles of 1980s women—including sexual harassment, sexual rights, sex education, and emotional autonomy—to the big screen. Featuring a then-newcomer Maggie Cheung alongside a talented new generation of writers including Wang Hsiao-di, Tsai Ming-liang, and Su Wei-chen, the film successfully blended star power with a fresh creative vision to achieve both commercial and artistic success.

synopsis: 1988 威尼斯影展最佳導演銀獅獎、國際影評人費比西獎、CICAE獎、天主教人道精神獎 Silver Lion for Best Director, FIPRESCI Prize, CICAE Award & 1989 柏林影展論壇單元基督教評審團獎 Interfilm Award, Forum, Berlinale 1989 歐洲電影獎最佳影片 European Film of the Year, European Film Awards 少女維拉與五歲弟弟亞歷山大，為找尋素未謀面的父親，瞞著母親登上火車，欲前往德國尋父。姊弟倆身無分文，甚至不知父親姓名，只能在車站、警局、公路間輾轉奔波。一路上，他們與善良青年結伴同行，也經歷成人世界的殘酷惡意。夜裡，兩人跨越邊境河岸，黑暗中槍聲乍響；天光漸亮，小姊弟的身影浮現，當濃霧散去，等待他們的究竟是父親，還是一場幻夢？ 安哲羅普洛斯「漂泊沉默三部曲」終篇，將自身童年喪父的記憶化為成長寓言，以長鏡頭舒展凝鍊而複雜的場面調度，映照戰後希臘的歷史創傷與時代變遷。姊弟尋找的不只是父親，更是希臘人失落的精神原鄉；蒼茫大霧中，兩人被迫提早辨識善與惡、愛與死，在童真幻滅之際，仍懷抱微渺希望前行。

tmdb_overview: 男孩亞歷山大常常在夢中見到未曾謀面的父親，他總和姊姊維拉兩人一起到車站月台等待，想像著搭上火車到遠方尋找父親的情境。有一天，夢想成真，姊弟倆總算有機會搭上一直期盼的火車，但他們身上一毛錢都沒有，更別說是車票和護照，就連父親的名字都不知道，很快地兩人被趕下車，只能漫無方向地前行。在這趟旅途中，姊弟倆目睹了錐心刺骨的死亡、體驗情竇初開的甜蜜與酸澀，以及世間的醜惡與殘酷。從原本懷抱著希望與期待的歡快啟程，到後來對人性與成長的絕望與幻滅，沈重的歷史與現實的枷鎖，一個 又一個地朝著姊弟倆套上。  這是一場成人世界對童真的追捕，一趟走向童年幻夢的毀滅公路之旅。劇情反映導演安哲羅普洛斯自幼遭逢的經歷，因為戰亂，他的孩提時光也在尋找父親身影中度過，超齡地見證死亡的黑暗；這也是一趟生命之旅，一路上孩子們學會所有的事物 ― 愛與死，謊言與真實、美麗與毀壞。鏡頭捕捉到的霧白風景，簡單的房舍、工業化的痕跡，沒有多餘的線條或色彩，荒蕪、寒冷的地景。在希臘著名作曲家伊蓮妮卡蘭卓（Eleni Karaindrou）宏大、宿命感濃厚的樂音中，手風琴和大提琴悠悠的樂音，流洩出無盡的悲傷情緒。本片呈現戰後深陷歷史矛盾情結的社會情景，快速成長的工業化及資本主義侵蝕希臘國族引以為傲的文化與地貌，註定流浪的一代人，即便早已失去了精神上的原鄉，但在晦暗之中似仍帶著一絲灰濛微渺的希望。

synopsis: 1990 德國曼漢姆影展首獎、基督教評審團獎 Grand Prize & Interfilm Award, IFF Mannheim-Heidelberg 1990 溫哥華影展最受歡迎加拿大電影 Most Popular Canadian Film, Vancouver IFF 1991 加拿大金尼獎最佳剪輯；提名最佳影片、女主角、女配角 Best Film Editing; nominated for Best Picture, Best Leading Actress 一輛巴士在林中意外拋錨，八名素昧平生的熟齡女性被迫下車，前往湖畔的荒棄小屋度夜。漫長的等待救援期間，她們從陌生試探到敞開心扉，開始傾訴家庭往事、私密愛欲，與對死亡的恐懼；亦攜手克服生存考驗，赴溪邊用褲襪捕魚、在田野抓青蛙充飢。一場意外滯留，讓這群身份背景殊異的長者，重新看見與陌生人連結的可能。 曾獲奧斯卡金獎肯定的紀錄片導演辛西亞史考特，與合作多年的加拿大國家電影局打造生涯唯一劇情長片。她親赴養老院選用非職業演員，匯集不同族裔、宗教、性向的銀髮女性群像，讓她們在虛構情境中本色演出，交織真實照片、即興對話，在虛實間透析人生遲暮風景，溫柔映現年長女性豐盈、多元的生命光譜。

synopsis: 2025 多倫多影展觀眾票選獎 People's Choice Award, Toronto IFF 2026 金球獎戲劇類最佳影片、女演員 Best Motion Picture & Best Actress (Drama), Golden Globes 2026 奧斯卡金像獎最佳女主角 Best Leading Actress, Academy Awards 16世紀末英國，拉丁語教師威廉在林中邂逅奔放不羈、深諳自然靈性的艾格妮絲，兩人旋即墜入愛河、生兒育女。鄉間生活無法滿足威廉，劇場夢驅使他往返倫敦追尋事業，留下艾格妮絲照料家人。大疫來襲，兩人愛的結晶猝然離世，夫妻感情亦深陷考驗。多年後，威廉苦心撰寫的悲劇《哈姆雷特》終登舞台。當人生無法重來，虛構戲劇能否替生者留住消逝的愛？ 趙婷與原著作者瑪姬歐法洛共同改編劇本，從女性視角切入史頁空隙，重新想像莎士比亞的家庭生活，並以靜謐空靈的鏡頭，細掘歷史人物的幽微情感。在舞台與現實之間，愛與死亡悄然換幕，生者的悼念，讓逝者化作偉大悲劇的幽靈；無法言說的傷痛，亦彷彿在戲劇重獲新生。 ◤關於電影的電影：幕間人生 All About Cinema: Between the Acts◢ 本季節目透過電影鏡頭，凝視劇場及現實生活的交會。幕間舞台下的悲歡流轉，是戲劇的停頓，亦是人生的轉場。且看創作者卸下面具、回望自身，在虛實交錯間，直抵幽微的生命真相。 哈姆奈特 莎翁情史 在車上 42街的凡尼亞

tmdb_overview: 1580年，英國。貧困的拉丁語家教威廉莎士比亞遇見自由奔放的艾格妮絲，兩人深受對方吸引，展開一段熾熱戀情，並迅速步入婚姻，與三個孩子過著幸福的生活。但當遠在倫敦的威廉戲劇事業迅速發展之際，艾格妮絲卻必須獨自撐起他們的家庭。突如其來的悲劇，讓這對夫妻曾經堅不可摧的羈絆就此受到嚴峻考驗，而這段經歷，也造就了莎士比亞的不朽傑作────〈哈姆雷特〉。
tmdb_overview_en: The powerful story of love and loss that inspired the creation of Shakespeare's timeless masterpiece, Hamlet.

synopsis: 原文發音、中文字幕 — 頂著學霸光環但土裡土氣的 Andy 幸運地在 Runway 雜誌得到了一份工作，那份全世界的女孩都想得到的工作。 而傳說中的主管 Miranda，強勢又尖酸刻薄，員工做得好應該，做不好就準備悲哀。Andy 在工作裡挫折不斷，且得不到認同，於是他決定改變自己，從讓自己看起來像個時尚產業的工作者開始。 但他渾然沒察覺到，改變的不只外表，這花花世界裡的光鮮亮麗，正逐漸瓦解他生活中的一切...... — Doors open 17:00｜Screening 18:00｜Runtime 1h 49m｜General Original audio, Mandarin subtitles — Fresh out of school, bookish and hopelessly unfashionable, Andy lands a job at Runway magazine — the job a million girls would kill for. Her legendary boss Miranda is formidable and cutting: do the job well and that is merely expected, do it badly and brace yourself. Battered by the work and getting no credit for it, Andy decides to change — starting by looking like someone who belongs in fashion. What she does not notice is that it is not only her appearance changing, and that all this glamour is quietly dismantling the rest of her life...... —

tmdb_overview: ＜RUNWAY＞雜誌是紐約時尚界聖經，總編米蘭達是難纏的大人物。只要稍有自尊的人，絕對無法在她手下工作，可是進入＜RUNWAY＞又是所有對時尚有熱情的年輕女孩最大的夢想。 剛畢業的社會新鮮人安德莉亞，憑著西北大學的漂亮履歷，進入＜RUNWAY＞位於曼哈頓總部辦公室。不服輸的她準備擔任米蘭達的助理。這名從頭到腳全是Prada的女士，將為她的人生帶來最殘酷的考驗。 漸漸地，安德莉亞讓自己融入米蘭達要求的氣質和形象，很短時間裡，她學會了這一行說話的模樣身段及行事方法。只是，當她越嫻熟米蘭達所在世界的遊戲規則，她也發現這其實是一個表面上精彩華麗但其實很孤獨的世界，值得嗎？安德莉亞靠自己找到她的答案。
tmdb_overview_en: A young woman from the Midwest gets more than she bargained for when she moves to New York to become a writer and ends up as the assistant to the tyrannical, larger-than-life editor-in-chief of a major fashion magazine.

synopsis: 1996 釜山影展 Pusan IFF 1996 亞太影展最佳編劇獎 Best Screenplay, Asia Pacific FF 1996 金馬獎最佳劇情片、男配角、原著劇本提名 Nominated for Best Feature Film, Supporting Actor 60歲的牙醫老陳在生日當天，爆出與幼稚園老師的婚外情，太太一氣之下離家出走，找上牛郎一解心中鬱悶。同時，兒子事業觸礁，女兒也打消結婚念頭，看似順遂美好的家庭劇本一夕之間全亂了。 導演張艾嘉以幽默筆觸描繪一個家庭的意外生命插曲。郎雄演繹的銀幕老爸充滿諷刺性，與其在李安作品中的父親截然不同。 Sixty-year-old Mr. Chen, still brimming with charisma, yearns for the fire of passion once more. His wish is granted when he falls for a kindergarten director. But when the affair comes to light, Mrs. Chen demands a divorce, shattering the family's façade. The son, entangled in his own life, ignores his father's indiscretions, while the daughter's faith in marriage crumbles. As the Chen family splinters, each family member embarks on their own path, entangled in affairs that mirror the father's, as they navigate the tumultuous waters of desire and betrayal.

synopsis: 原文發音、中文字幕 — Jerry 是個王牌運動明星經紀人，事業愛情兩得意——那是在他寫了一封洋洋灑灑的建議信給老闆之前。 現在的他，手上的合約只剩下一個不起眼的二線球員 Rod，還有一個莫名其妙受感召的會計，單親媽媽 Dorothy。 於是他們三個決定攜手重新開始，重新創業，重新開始彼此的人生。 — Doors open 20:10｜Screening 20:40｜Runtime 2h 19m｜Parental Guidance Original audio, Mandarin subtitles — Jerry is a star sports agent with the career and the relationship to match — right up until the night he writes his boss a long memo about how the business ought to treat people. All he has left now is Rod, an unremarkable second-string player, and Dorothy, a single mother in accounting who inexplicably believed every word of it. And so the three of them decide to start over — a new company, and new lives all round. —

tmdb_overview: 一個星期前，傑利麥高瑞還是被公司捧在手心上的首席運動明星經紀人。他一表人才、聰明絕頂，手中握有許多王牌球員的經紀約，他的未婚妻則是全美足球聯盟的美麗公關，35歲的傑利意氣風發極了！但一天夜裡，他有感而發，洋洋洒洒的寫了一篇工作感言，並大膽對公司提出建言：〝提昇服務客戶品質，以質取勝，只有客戶而不是賺錢，才是真正重要。〞這篇感言使公司老闆在一個星期後開除他，所有王牌球員也都改投別人門下，甚至連女朋友也棄他而去！當他離開公司時，只帶走一條魚、一個信任他的二線球員羅德（古巴古丁二世飾）以及受他精神感召的會計小組桃樂帝（瑞妮齊威格飾），一個26歲的單親媽媽。三個人準備重新創業，重新當社會新鮮人。但現實並未如想像中順利，傑利到處碰壁，脾氣火爆的羅德又不肯好好合作，即使有桃樂帝和她三歲兒子的鼓勵，傑利還是瀕臨破產的危機…
tmdb_overview_en: Jerry Maguire used to be a typical sports agent: willing to do just about anything he could to get the biggest possible contracts for his clients, plus a nice commission for himself. Then, one day, he suddenly has second thoughts about what he's really doing. When he voices these doubts, he ends up losing his job and all of his clients, save Rod Tidwell, an egomaniacal football player.

synopsis: 2020 威尼斯影展金獅獎 Golden Lion, Venice FF 2020 多倫多影展觀眾票選獎 People's Choice Award, Toronto IFF 2021 奧斯卡金像獎最佳影片、導演、女主角 Best Picture, Best Director & Best Leading Actress, Academy 芬恩失去工作、家園與丈夫後，將僅存家當裝進一輛破舊廂型車，踏上沒有終點的公路之旅。她隨季節流徙各地、打工營生，摸索脫離社會常規的漂泊生活，更結識一群以車為家的當代游牧者。他們有人嚮往在荒野共築家園，有人利用短暫餘命追尋自由，彼此相濡以沫、交換人生故事，並在一次次相遇與別離後各自上路，後會無期。 本片改編潔西卡布魯德的報導文學，邀請多位真實「車居族」共演，刻劃金融海嘯後頓失家園、仰賴零工經濟的無依人生。從運轉不歇的亞馬遜物流中心，到被遺棄的無人工業鎮，當資本無形巨手改寫了當代勞動風景，導演趙婷揉雜紀實元素，細覽美國廣袤大地，辨識渺小個體的勞動與生存痕跡，重新顯影其尊嚴與韌性。 Bruder's nonfiction book, Chloé Zhao blends fiction and documentary, tracing

synopsis: 1974 盧卡諾影展 Locarno FF 1974 紐約影展 New York FF 1976 德國電影評論學會獎最佳電影 Best Film, German Film Critics Association Awards 旅美多年的德國記者菲力普陷入寫作低潮，失意踏上返鄉之路。他在機場邂逅一對母女，未料母親為挽救情郎，竟將八歲幼女愛麗絲託付給素昧平生的菲力普。當母親未依約現身，菲力普只得帶愛麗絲從荷蘭一路奔赴德國，憑藉她對母親故鄉的零碎記憶，展開曲折的尋親之旅。 溫德斯「公路電影三部曲」首篇，以詩意黑白鏡頭捕捉城市風景，將地理空間轉化為陌生影像，探索記憶與現實的扞格：主角對眼前風景備感疏離，只能用相片留下虛無見證；愛麗絲記不清家鄉名字，卻堅稱能憑記憶辨識家屋模樣。兩個迷途的靈魂一路走走停停，但上路的意義並非抵達終點，而是在陪伴中與他人建立連結，循著情感與記憶的座標，重新指認自我的歸屬。

synopsis: 2024 安錫國際動畫影展 Annecy International Animation FF 在色彩繽紛、熱情奔放的墨西哥科約阿坎小鎮，住著一個與眾不同的小女孩。對這個世界充滿無窮好奇心的她，即使面對生命突如其來的考驗與折磨，也總能用天馬行空的想像力迎頭擊破。這個勇敢、燦爛又獨一無二的小女孩，名字就叫——芙烈達卡蘿！本片以充滿童趣與藝術感的視覺風格，帶領我們借用小芙烈達的眼睛，看見想像力如何化為力量，將生活的痛楚綻放出最耀眼的色彩。 Welcome to the vibrant world of Coyoacán, Mexico, home to an extraordinary little girl with endless curiosity. When faced with life's painful trials, she confronts them not with tears, but with a boundless, dazzling imagination. Her name is Frida Kahlo! Through whimsical art and infectious energy, this enchanting film invites us to see the world through young Frida's eyes, showing how the power of imagination and spirit can turn life's toughest obstacles into a masterpiece of courage and color. ◤童心電影院：借一雙電影眼 Theater of Wonders: Through Magic Movie Eyes!◢ 本季邀請大小朋友戴上魔法眼鏡，從藝術家的想像、戰火角落的勇氣、異鄉童年的驚奇，到微觀世界的冒險，讓我們借用他人眼睛，學習同理心、擁抱世界多樣性，開展自由飛翔的魔法之旅吧！ 小小畫家芙烈達 小雨愛蜜莉 Little Amélie or the Character of Rain 戰火下的小花 魔籽公主

tmdb_overview: 這是一個關於一位與眾不同的小女孩的故事。她的名字叫做芙烈達·卡蘿！故事從她的童年與青年時期出發，在墨西哥的科約阿坎，一個閃耀而充滿生命力的地方展開。這裡的一切都今她充滿好奇，也讓她在成長的每一刻，都以敏銳而炙熱的感知擁抱世界。當困難與病痛來臨時，她從不退縮，而是以豐富而奔放的想像力去面對。那些痛苦、孤獨與愛，在她的眼中逐漸轉化為色彩與形狀，滲入畫布之中，成為無法被抹去的生命印記。正如芙烈達所說：「我從不畫夢境，我畫的是我的現實。」她的創作不逃避現實，反而直視生命最真實的傷口與光芒。
tmdb_overview_en: It’s the story of a little girl who is different. Her world is Coyoacan, Mexico City. Sparkling, vibrant, everything interests her and when difficulties arise, she faces them with an overflowing imagination. This little girl is called Frida Kahlo.

His wish is granted when he falls for a kindergarten director. But when the affair comes to light, Mrs. Chen demands a divorce, shattering the family's façade. The son, entangled in his own life, ignores his father's indiscretions, while the daughter's faith in marriage crumbles. As the Chen family splinters, each family member embarks on their own path, entangled in affairs that mirror the father's, as they navigate the tumultuous waters of desire and betrayal.

synopsis: 1974 盧卡諾影展 Locarno FF 1974 紐約影展 New York FF 1976 德國電影評論學會獎最佳電影 Best Film, German Film Critics Association Awards 旅美多年的德國記者菲力普陷入寫作低潮，失意踏上返鄉之路。他在機場邂逅一對母女，未料母親為挽救情郎，竟將八歲幼女愛麗絲託付給素昧平生的菲力普。當母親未依約現身，菲力普只得帶愛麗絲從荷蘭一路奔赴德國，憑藉她對母親故鄉的零碎記憶，展開曲折的尋親之旅。 溫德斯「公路電影三部曲」首篇，以詩意黑白鏡頭捕捉城市風景，將地理空間轉化為陌生影像，探索記憶與現實的扞格：主角對眼前風景備感疏離，只能用相片留下虛無見證；愛麗絲記不清家鄉名字，卻堅稱能憑記憶辨識家屋模樣。兩個迷途的靈魂一路走走停停，但上路的意義並非抵達終點，而是在陪伴中與他人建立連結，循著情感與記憶的座標，重新指認自我的歸屬。

synopsis: 才華洋溢的音樂老師洪一峰來到台灣南部任教，和邂逅的少女月霞陷入熱戀，卻無法抵擋月霞養父逼迫她嫁給有錢人，洪一峰更被迫離職前往異地謀生，月霞循線追上，並產下一女。當兩人以為生活即將安穩，月霞養父卻上門無情拆散一家三口。幾年後，女兒跟著褓母到台北尋找生母，卻不慎走散，投身歌壇並迅速竄紅的洪一峰，只能冀望藉著名氣，在茫茫人海中尋到妻女。 本片由擅長文藝歌唱題材的邵羅輝執導，以戀愛自由與階級衝突為基調，為「寶島歌王」洪一峰打造電影長片。片中穿插多首流行歌曲，融合日本民謠、民間小調與原創旋律，伴隨城市霓虹的燈火闌珊，記錄下台北舊城輪廓與台語流行文化的黃金時代，一曲溫柔雋永的〈舊情綿綿〉餘韻未停。 A gifted music teacher falls in love with a young woman in southern Taiwan, their bond unfolds under the quiet moonlit sky. But her foster father's ambition forces them apart, even after she escapes to build a life with her lover and their newborn daughter. Years later, separated yet still bound by longing, they wait for the chance to reunite. Directed by Shao Lo-hui and led by "King of Song," Hong Yi-feng, the film expands from his celebrated hit to portray a tender, restrained love story at the heart of classic Taiyupian cinema.

synopsis_en:
Talented music teacher Hong Yi-feng travels to southern Taiwan to teach, where he falls into a passionate romance with a young woman named Yue-xia. Their love, however, faces the cruel opposition of Yue-xia’s foster father, who pressures her into an arranged marriage with a wealthy man. Forced to leave his position and seek a living elsewhere, Hong is eventually joined by Yue-xia, and the couple welcomes a daughter. But just as they begin to find peace, the foster father tracks them down and ruthlessly tears the family apart.

Years later, their daughter travels to Taipei with her nanny to search for her mother, only to become lost in the city. Meanwhile, Hong Yi-feng has become a sensation in the music world; he clings to the hope that his fame will help him find his long-lost wife and daughter in the vast crowd. Directed by Shao Lo-hui, a specialist in romantic musicals, this feature film was tailor-made for the "King of Formosan Song," Hong Yi-feng. Centered on themes of romantic freedom and class conflict, the film weaves together popular hits, Japanese folk songs, and original melodies. Amidst the glimmering neon lights of the city, it preserves the landscape of old Taipei and the golden age of Taiwanese-language pop culture, leaving behind the timeless, tender resonance of the classic song "Old Love is Everlasting."

Ah-Qiang is a junior high senior with mediocre grades. His life is a dull grind, and his only solace is dreaming of wandering through a tranquil underwater world. One day, driven by curiosity, he attempts to investigate the kidnapping of an elementary school student, only to stumble into the trap and become a hostage himself. As the high school entrance exams loom, the adults are thrown into a frenzy, scrambling over ransom money and elite school placements. Meanwhile, Ah-Qiang and the young boy are whisked away to the south, where they unexpectedly enjoy a carefree "summer vacation."

The directorial debut of Chen Yu-hsun, the film uses a kidnapping plot to humorously satirize academic obsession and social absurdity, establishing itself as a classic of Taiwanese absurdist comedy.

synopsis: 2009 柏林影展 Berlinale 2009 阿姆斯特丹國際紀錄片影展 IDFA 2026 台灣國際紀錄片影展 TIDF 自19世紀末起，蒙大拿州牧人沿襲百年的高山放牧長征，於2003年劃下句點。作為感官民族誌實驗室的開山之作，本片隨行記錄最後的遠行，肩背鏡頭與同步音景深入牧人與羊群之間，模糊了自然與文化、人與動物的界線，共譜不落窠臼的西部輓歌。 面對「新西部」雅痞化與土地變遷，導演企圖重拾被人類學界視為陳舊的「搶救式民族誌」，在直視傳統消亡的同時，摒棄居高臨下的浪漫化想像與懷舊濫情，回歸最純粹的體感與聲景，凝縮極具詩意且真實深刻的生命面貌。 follows the final sheep drive through Montana's mountains, marking the end of a century-old tradition. With shoulder-mounted cameras and immersive soundscapes, the film dissolves boundaries between human and animal, nature and culture in an unsentimental Western elegy. Prompted by the gentrification of the Rockies, the directors re-engage with "salvage ethnography," capturing a vanishing world through pure sensory experience while avoiding nostalgic romanticism.

synopsis: 2010 盧卡諾影展 Locarno FF 2011 法國真實影展 Cinéma du Réel 2026 台灣國際紀錄片影展 TIDF 起重機刺穿擋風玻璃，搖晃架起汽車鬆脫解體。在紐約皇后區即將拆遷的工業社區，鏡頭深入以廢車廠為家的移民社群。橫跨四季，人流與車流交替，叫嚷敲打如交響曲。苦樂混雜不失片刻愜意，機械與人類的生命在此循環相映。未來一片泥濘，光鮮建設之後，權益尚待爭取。廢棄零件散落一地，顛沛的人們又該往何處去？ 導演維瑞娜帕拉韋爾將居民受創卻堅韌的生命，折射為後工業發展、移民潮與環境惡化的集體寓言；史杰鵬則抽離旁白與評論，賦予觀眾直接沉浸於音畫的自由。本片捨棄傳統說理，以美麗與汙穢並存、混亂卻自有其序的狀態，呈現了美國歷史中更為宏大的篇章──諸如後工業社會、移民潮、政治暴力、環境惡化，以及民主制度的崩解。 observes an immigrant community surviving amid auto scrapyards. Directors Véréna Paravel and J.P. Sniadecki capture the rhythm between mechanical breakdown and human life across four seasons. Paravel sees the ruined cars reflecting residents' precarious lives, encapsulating post-industrial decay and immigration politics. Eschewing voiceover, Sniadecki grants audiences the freedom to inhabit the site's raw sensory ecosystem and interpret its fragile, resilient reality.

synopsis: 2010 盧卡諾影展 Locarno FF 2011 法國真實影展 Cinéma du Réel 2026 台灣國際紀錄片影展 TIDF 起重機刺穿擋風玻璃，搖晃架起汽車鬆脫解體。在紐約皇后區即將拆遷的工業社區，鏡頭深入以廢車廠為家的移民社群。橫跨四季，人流與車流交替，叫嚷敲打如交響曲。苦樂混雜不失片刻愜意，機械與人類的生命在此循環相映。未來一片泥濘，光鮮建設之後，權益尚待爭取。廢棄零件散落一地，顛沛的人們又該往何處去？ 導演維瑞娜帕拉韋爾將居民受創卻堅韌的生命，折射為後工業發展、移民潮與環境惡化的集體寓言；史杰鵬則抽離旁白與評論，賦予觀眾直接沉浸於音畫的自由。本片捨棄傳統說理，以美麗與汙穢並存、混亂卻自有其序的狀態，呈現了美國歷史中更為宏大的篇章──諸如後工業社會、移民潮、政治暴力、環境惡化，以及民主制度的崩解。 observes an immigrant community surviving amid auto scrapyards. Directors Véréna Paravel and J.P. Sniadecki capture the rhythm between mechanical breakdown and human life across four seasons. Paravel sees the ruined cars reflecting residents' precarious lives, encapsulating post-industrial decay and immigration politics. Eschewing voiceover, Sniadecki grants audiences the freedom to inhabit the site's raw sensory ecosystem and interpret its fragile, resilient reality.

synopsis: 2022 坎城影展 Cannes FF 2022 阿姆斯特丹紀錄片影展 IDFA 2026 台灣國際紀錄片影展 TIDF 巴黎公立醫院內，重大手術日復一日上演，是震撼的生死瞬間，也是平庸的日常勞動。全片採人類學式的參與觀察，將悚然的血腥手術、內視鏡攝影，搭配醫療人員一派輕鬆的操演，冷靜透析人體內外熟悉又陌生的奇異風景。片名引用五百年前解剖學名著，將血肉敞開於銀幕，宛如鏡像般令人反思生與死、自我與他者的連結。 導演表示，團隊為突破傳統攝影的距離感，特別委製微型鏡頭，使體內與體外視角相疊合，連結器械與肉身，揭示人與萬物交織的相互依存關係，試圖以嶄新視角敞開肉身，為靜止的解剖圖譜注入動態、時間與聲響。 opens the human body to cinema within Paris hospitals. Directors Véréna Paravel and Lucien Castaing-Taylor note that the film aims to re-examine the flesh by infusing static anatomy with movement, time, texture, and sound. Rejecting conventional cameras, they used a custom miniature lens to bridge medical endoscopy with external observational footage, encouraging viewers to rethink interiority and exteriority, self and other, and the interdependencies connecting all bodies.

Ah-Qiang is a junior high senior with mediocre grades. His life is a dull grind, and his only solace is dreaming of wandering through a tranquil underwater world. One day, driven by curiosity, he attempts to investigate the kidnapping of an elementary school student, only to stumble into the trap and become a hostage himself. As the high school entrance exams loom, the adults are thrown into a frenzy, scrambling over ransom money and elite school placements. Meanwhile, Ah-Qiang and the young boy are whisked away to the south, where they unexpectedly enjoy a carefree "summer vacation."

The directorial debut of Chen Yu-hsun, the film uses a kidnapping plot to humorously satirize academic obsession and social absurdity, establishing itself as a classic of Taiwanese absurdist comedy.

Directors Véréna Paravel and Lucien Castaing-Taylor note that the film aims to re-examine the flesh by infusing static anatomy with movement, time, texture, and sound. Rejecting conventional cameras, they used a custom miniature lens to bridge medical endoscopy with external observational footage, encouraging viewers to rethink interiority and exteriority, self and other, and the interdependencies connecting all bodies.

synopsis: 才華洋溢的音樂老師洪一峰來到台灣南部任教，和邂逅的少女月霞陷入熱戀，卻無法抵擋月霞養父逼迫她嫁給有錢人，洪一峰更被迫離職前往異地謀生，月霞循線追上，並產下一女。當兩人以為生活即將安穩，月霞養父卻上門無情拆散一家三口。幾年後，女兒跟著褓母到台北尋找生母，卻不慎走散，投身歌壇並迅速竄紅的洪一峰，只能冀望藉著名氣，在茫茫人海中尋到妻女。 本片由擅長文藝歌唱題材的邵羅輝執導，以戀愛自由與階級衝突為基調，為「寶島歌王」洪一峰打造電影長片。片中穿插多首流行歌曲，融合日本民謠、民間小調與原創旋律，伴隨城市霓虹的燈火闌珊，記錄下台北舊城輪廓與台語流行文化的黃金時代，一曲溫柔雋永的〈舊情綿綿〉餘韻未停。 A gifted music teacher falls in love with a young woman in southern Taiwan, their bond unfolds under the quiet moonlit sky. But her foster father's ambition forces them apart, even after she escapes to build a life with her lover and their newborn daughter. Years later, separated yet still bound by longing, they wait for the chance to reunite. Directed by Shao Lo-hui and led by "King of Song," Hong Yi-feng, the film expands from his celebrated hit to portray a tender, restrained love story at the heart of classic Taiyupian cinema.

synopsis_en:
Talented music teacher Hong Yi-feng travels to southern Taiwan to teach, where he falls into a passionate romance with a young woman named Yue-xia. Their love, however, faces the cruel opposition of Yue-xia’s foster father, who pressures her into an arranged marriage with a wealthy man. Forced to leave his position and seek a living elsewhere, Hong is eventually joined by Yue-xia, and the couple welcomes a daughter. But just as they begin to find peace, the foster father tracks them down and ruthlessly tears the family apart.

Years later, their daughter travels to Taipei with her nanny to search for her mother, only to become lost in the city. Meanwhile, Hong Yi-feng has become a sensation in the music world; he clings to the hope that his fame will help him find his long-lost wife and daughter in the vast crowd. Directed by Shao Lo-hui, a specialist in romantic musicals, this feature film was tailor-made for the "King of Formosan Song," Hong Yi-feng. Centered on themes of romantic freedom and class conflict, the film weaves together popular hits, Japanese folk songs, and original melodies. Amidst the glimmering neon lights of the city, it preserves the landscape of old Taipei and the golden age of Taiwanese-language pop culture, leaving behind the timeless, tender resonance of the classic song "Old Love is Everlasting."

synopsis: 1995 盧卡諾影展藍豹獎 Blue Leopard, Locarno FF 1995 金馬獎最佳原著劇本﹑最佳女配角 Best Original Screenplay & Best Supporting Actress, Golden Horse Awards 功課平平的國三生阿強，生活苦悶，唯有夢裡悠遊海底世界才能自得其樂。某天他因好奇追查小學生綁架案，卻不慎自投羅網，變成了另一名肉票。眼看高中聯考逼近，大人們為了名校與贖金東奔西跑、陣腳大亂；被押往南部的阿強與小肉票，卻意外迎來了一段無憂無慮的暑假。陳玉勳首部執導作品，以綁架案詼諧諷刺升學主義與社會亂象，開創台灣荒謬喜劇經典。 * 本 節目 提供口述影像服務，觀影期間可能產生些微設備聲響，敬請理解與體諒。 * This program provides Mandarin audio description service. synopsis_en:
Blue Leopard, 1995 Locarno Film Festival
Best Original Screenplay & Best Supporting Actress, 1995 Golden Horse Awards

Ah-Qiang is a junior high senior with mediocre grades. His life is a dull grind, and his only solace is dreaming of wandering through a tranquil underwater world. One day, driven by curiosity, he attempts to investigate the kidnapping of an elementary school student, only to stumble into the trap and become a hostage himself. As the high school entrance exams loom, the adults are thrown into a frenzy, scrambling over ransom money and elite school placements. Meanwhile, Ah-Qiang and the young boy are whisked away to the south, where they unexpectedly enjoy a carefree "summer vacation."

The directorial debut of Chen Yu-hsun, the film uses a kidnapping plot to humorously satirize academic obsession and social absurdity, establishing itself as a classic of Taiwanese absurdist comedy.

synopsis: 2021 坎城影展最佳劇本 Best Screenplay, Cannes FF 2022 奧斯卡金像獎最佳國際影片 Best International Feature Film, Academy Awards 妻子意外猝逝兩年後，劇場導演悠介受邀前往廣島藝術節執導多語版本的《凡尼亞舅舅》。排演期間，他結識沉默寡言的代駕司機美沙紀，一趟趟穿梭城市的車程，讓兩個各自背負傷痕的靈魂，逐漸駛入不願回望的記憶。舞台上，演員以不同語言反覆念著契訶夫的台詞；舞台下，悠介也開始聽見那些自己始終無法說出口的話。 濱口 竜 介融合村上春樹短篇小說集《沒有女人的男人們》的不同篇章，並將契訶夫經典劇作《凡尼亞舅舅》延伸為核心文本。對濱口而言，契訶夫筆下的凡尼亞與悠介、索尼婭與女性角色們彼此映照，戲劇不再只是被搬演的舞台文本，更是理解幕後人生的媒介。當演員反覆說出別人的台詞，角色與自身、虛構與現實也在排演之間隱然嵌合。 ◤關於電影的電影：幕間人生 All About Cinema: Between the Acts◢ 本季節目透過電影鏡頭，凝視劇場及現實生活的交會。幕間舞台下的悲歡流轉，是戲劇的停頓，亦是人生的轉場。且看創作者卸下面具、回望自身，在虛實交錯間，直抵幽微的生命真相。 哈姆奈特 莎翁情史 在車上 42街的凡尼亞

tmdb_overview: 在意外喪妻兩年後，知名的舞台劇演員及導演家福裕介（西島秀俊 飾）被邀請為廣島戲劇節製作舞台劇。在那裡，因工作關係需要聘請一位汽車代駕，家福遇見了沈默寡言的美沙紀（三浦透子 飾），兩人在一趟趟安靜的車程中，漸漸瞭解了彼此的過往，也解開了自己難解的心結，更發現了心愛妻子生前的秘密......
tmdb_overview_en: Yusuke Kafuku, a stage actor and director, still unable, after two years, to cope with the loss of his beloved wife, accepts to direct Uncle Vanya at a theater festival in Hiroshima. There he meets Misaki, an introverted young woman, appointed to drive his car. In between rides, secrets from the past and heartfelt confessions will be unveiled.

director: 安德烈卡迪 André KADI、瑪麗亞扎里夫 Marya ZARIF
synopsis: 2022 安錫國際動畫影展 Annecy International Animation FF 六歲的敘利亞女孩杜妮亞，深愛著充滿香氣與歷史的阿勒坡古城。然而，戰火的暴風突然襲來，迫使她與阿公阿嬤揮別家園，踏上尋找新家的漫長旅程。面對險阻，杜妮亞緊握著手中的神奇黑種草籽，相信傳說中的「阿勒坡公主」正悄悄守護著她 ， 再洶湧的大海都將如搖籃般溫柔，再冰冷的邊界也隨舞蹈而敞開。本片以優雅靈動的童話風格，雜揉阿拉伯神話與動人音樂，帶領我們透過孩子的眼睛，看見在動盪世界中綻放的勇氣與奇蹟。 Six-year-old Dounia loves her home in the vibrant city of Aleppo. But when war breaks out, she is forced to leave everything behind and set off on a journey to find a new home with her grandparents. Faced with uncertainty, Dounia holds tightly to a handful of magical black cumin seeds, trusting that the legendary Princess of Aleppo will protect them along the way. With gentle fairytale realism and mesmerizing Middle Eastern melodies, this heart-touching animation invites us to see the world through a child's eyes—where courage, imagination, and love transform a harrowing refugee journey into a magical quest for hope. ◤童心電影院：借一雙電影眼 Theater of Wonders: Through Magic Movie Eyes!◢ 本季邀請大小朋友戴上魔法眼鏡，從藝術家的想像、戰火角落的勇氣、異鄉童年的驚奇，到微觀世界的冒險，讓我們借用他人眼睛，學習同理心、擁抱世界多樣性，開展自由飛翔的魔法之旅吧！ 小小畫家芙烈達 小雨愛蜜莉 Little Amélie or the Character of Rain 戰火下的小花 魔籽公主

tmdb_overview: 六歲的杜妮亞是個活潑開朗的敘利亞女孩，深愛著位於阿勒坡古城的家園。那裡有醞釀千年的文化，也有繽紛齊放的香氣。遺憾的是，她最心愛的母親英年早逝，富正義感的父親也無端陷冤獄，戰爭的爆發又迫使杜妮亞和阿公阿嬤逃離家鄉，踏上尋找新家的驚奇旅程。儘管眼前充滿挑戰，杜妮亞相信手中的魔法黑種草籽和神話中的阿勒坡公主會守護他們。再洶湧的大海，會如搖籃安穩；再緊閉的邊界，會隨舞蹈敞開。
tmdb_overview_en: Forced to leave Syria because of the war, Dounia and her grandparents go in search of a new safe haven. As she traverses the world in search of asylum, Dounia draws strength from the wisdom of the ancient world, brought to light by her grandmother's magic nigella seeds.

synopsis: 1988 威尼斯影展最佳導演銀獅獎、國際影評人費比西獎、CICAE獎、天主教人道精神獎 Silver Lion for Best Director, FIPRESCI Prize, CICAE Award & 1989 柏林影展論壇單元基督教評審團獎 Interfilm Award, Forum, Berlinale 1989 歐洲電影獎最佳影片 European Film of the Year, European Film Awards 少女維拉與五歲弟弟亞歷山大，為找尋素未謀面的父親，瞞著母親登上火車，欲前往德國尋父。姊弟倆身無分文，甚至不知父親姓名，只能在車站、警局、公路間輾轉奔波。一路上，他們與善良青年結伴同行，也經歷成人世界的殘酷惡意。夜裡，兩人跨越邊境河岸，黑暗中槍聲乍響；天光漸亮，小姊弟的身影浮現，當濃霧散去，等待他們的究竟是父親，還是一場幻夢？ 安哲羅普洛斯「漂泊沉默三部曲」終篇，將自身童年喪父的記憶化為成長寓言，以長鏡頭舒展凝鍊而複雜的場面調度，映照戰後希臘的歷史創傷與時代變遷。姊弟尋找的不只是父親，更是希臘人失落的精神原鄉；蒼茫大霧中，兩人被迫提早辨識善與惡、愛與死，在童真幻滅之際，仍懷抱微渺希望前行。

tmdb_overview: 男孩亞歷山大常常在夢中見到未曾謀面的父親，他總和姊姊維拉兩人一起到車站月台等待，想像著搭上火車到遠方尋找父親的情境。有一天，夢想成真，姊弟倆總算有機會搭上一直期盼的火車，但他們身上一毛錢都沒有，更別說是車票和護照，就連父親的名字都不知道，很快地兩人被趕下車，只能漫無方向地前行。在這趟旅途中，姊弟倆目睹了錐心刺骨的死亡、體驗情竇初開的甜蜜與酸澀，以及世間的醜惡與殘酷。從原本懷抱著希望與期待的歡快啟程，到後來對人性與成長的絕望與幻滅，沈重的歷史與現實的枷鎖，一個 又一個地朝著姊弟倆套上。  這是一場成人世界對童真的追捕，一趟走向童年幻夢的毀滅公路之旅。劇情反映導演安哲羅普洛斯自幼遭逢的經歷，因為戰亂，他的孩提時光也在尋找父親身影中度過，超齡地見證死亡的黑暗；這也是一趟生命之旅，一路上孩子們學會所有的事物 ― 愛與死，謊言與真實、美麗與毀壞。鏡頭捕捉到的霧白風景，簡單的房舍、工業化的痕跡，沒有多餘的線條或色彩，荒蕪、寒冷的地景。在希臘著名作曲家伊蓮妮卡蘭卓（Eleni Karaindrou）宏大、宿命感濃厚的樂音中，手風琴和大提琴悠悠的樂音，流洩出無盡的悲傷情緒。本片呈現戰後深陷歷史矛盾情結的社會情景，快速成長的工業化及資本主義侵蝕希臘國族引以為傲的文化與地貌，註定流浪的一代人，即便早已失去了精神上的原鄉，但在晦暗之中似仍帶著一絲灰濛微渺的希望。
tmdb_overview_en: Two Greek children embark on a journey to search for their father, who supposedly lives in Germany.
